title: Reflections
desc: Writing about technology, innovation, career and the role of those who build software.

items.title: O que o WTICIFES 2026 me mostrou sobre o futuro da TI nas universidades federais
items.desc: Report from WTICIFES 2026 (Garibaldi, RS), based on more than 200 presented papers, analysing automation and integration cases in Brazilian federal universities — UFSCar auditable draw, the UFFS WhatsApp assistant and UNIFESP voting automation — and arguing that technology is increasingly used as a means to solve concrete problems rather than as an end in itself.

items.title: Paper, Pen and Knife: From Implementation to Specification — The Developer's New Responsibility (PT-BR)
items.desc: Reflection on how artificial intelligence is shifting the developer's responsibility, moving from implementation author to author of expected software behavior, using the paper, pen and knife metaphor.

items.title: A Letter to Anyone Who Arrived Here (PT-BR)
items.desc: A welcome letter introducing his Medium space, his journey, curiosity, and the purpose of sharing knowledge to connect people and inspire new discoveries.

items.title: Beyond Labels: The Potential Still Waiting for Opportunities (PT-BR)
items.desc: Reflection on human potential, prejudice, and labels that limit people. Shows how opportunities and support can reveal hidden talents, with a personal story about persistence and learning.

items.title: Change: Fear or Opportunity? (PT-BR)
items.desc: Reflection on facing change with a positive mindset, turning challenges into growth opportunities, with practical tips for dealing with scary transitions.

items.title: Far Beyond the Code (PT-BR)
items.desc: Deep reflection on legacy, technology, and people. A personal journey of over three decades in computing, exploring how the true impact of IT work lies not in the systems developed, but in the people we help grow and the knowledge we share.

items.title: What is innovation after all? Where does it come from? (PT-BR)
items.desc: Reflection on the nature of innovation, questioning whether it arises from new technologies or from a deeper understanding of human problems. An analysis of how true innovation comes from the ability to understand people and transform realities.

items.title: How Much Is My Work Worth in IT: Am I Relevant? How to Combat Impostor Syndrome (PT-BR)
items.desc: Reflection on the value of work in the IT field, the feeling of professional relevance, and strategies to deal with impostor syndrome.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Cognitive Revolution or the Revolution of Haste (PT-BR)
items.desc: Reflection on the real impact of Artificial Intelligence, questioning whether we face a true cognitive revolution or merely an intellectual shortcut that may compromise the learning process.

items.title: Your portfolio is not an HTML resume (and that's okay)
items.desc: Reflection on the differences between a portfolio and a resume, and how to better structure your professional presentation.
